correctness.rationale: For each category i and sample pair e, condition on X_a=X_b: E[I_iY_e]=p_i²+(q2-p_i²)(1-(1-p_i)^(n-2)); subtract (1-(1-p_i)^n)q2 to obtain p_i(1-p_i)^(n-2)[p_i-(2-p_i)q2]. Sum over pairs gives exact covariance. Size-biased / weighted rearrangement yields strict negative for all finite nondegenerate categorical laws, including n=2. Uniform formula follows by substitution. For n/sqrt(m)→c>0 uniform, discrepancy C_n-(n-K_n) is bounded by colliding triples; E[T_n²]→0 at n=O(sqrt(m)), so L² discrepancy vanishes. Pair-collision indicators are pairwise independent for uniform law, Var(C_n)→c²/2>0, giving correlation -1. Independent rational sample-space enumeration for m=2,3,5 and n=2..5 matched exact formula.
